known.summary: The updated Kotlin reference still says `sealed` constrains subclasses to the same compilation unit (Kotlin 1.5+), but Kotlin 1.5+ allows direct subclasses anywhere in the same package and module (the same source set in multiplatform projects), so the guidance makes users reject valid class layouts.

The plan-record blocks of refactor and security now state that the issue always carries `plan` plus exactly one of the four phase labels, but these skills only create the issue with `plan:drafting` and plan-manager owns every later phase transition (a closed plan carries no phase label), so the block states a label invariant that the skill neither sets nor keeps instead of the creation state and the manager's ownership.
